entry.title: Degree name different from passport?
entry.summary: A degree, passport or CNIC that shows a different spelling or a missing surname needs the right issuer, not another stamp. Compare the records first.

entry.title: MOFA attestation: where to begin
entry.summary: Start with the document category and the authority that comes before the foreign affairs stage, then confirm the current instructions for your document.

entry.title: Mosadaqa degree attestation in Pakistan
entry.summary: Mosadaqa means attestation or verification of a document for Saudi use. See which records must match and how name differences are resolved.

entry.title: Apostille or embassy legalization?
entry.summary: The applicable route depends on treaty status, the document and the recipient, not the destination name alone. Check the right question first.

entry.title: HEC or IBCC: which authority applies?
entry.summary: Look at the qualification level and awarding body rather than the word “certificate” when you decide which educational authority to approach.

entry.title: Why was your document rejected?
entry.summary: A query or rejection notice tells you which part of the file needs attention. Read the stated reason before you resubmit or pay again.
